dates.flourished: 14th c. (contemporary of Sufi missionary activity in Kashmir)
dates.note: Kashmiri-language mystic poetess; dates traditional Birth ~1320 (approx).

name: Lalla (Lal Ded, Lalleshvari)
summary: Fourteenth-century Kashmiri mystic poetess: the Vakhyani speak nondual recognition in the vernacular.
bio: Fourteenth-century Kashmiri mystic poetess (Lalleshvari): the Vakhyani sayings speak nondual recognition in the vernacular — jnana as direct tasting. Kashmiri language; Hoskote/Grierson-Barnett/Kaul carry the English.

image.caption: Kashmiri miniature deities within the Sharada Omkara glyph (PD): mystic-syllable art of Lalla’s Kashmir. Context art, not portrait (none exists).
